demoted._modifier: SQL partitions it. Every modifier here is bound to one construct — `DISTINCT` only after SELECT, `TEMPORARY` only after CREATE, `ASC` only in an ordering term, `NOT NULL` only in a column definition — so one alternation reachable from all of those positions accepts `SELECT TEMPORARY`, `CREATE DISTINCT TABLE` and `ORDER BY x PRIMARY KEY`. All eighteen members are concrete node types occurring nowhere else, so facet membership selects exactly the nodes the supertype would have.
